nom: Hero Cosmetics Mighty Patch Day & Night

avis.texte: These are great and the invisible day patches are perfection. I'm 61 and still get breakouts so I really need these. They also prevent me from touching the blemish. I highly recommend!

avis.titre: I will buy this product for the rest of my life!!
avis.texte: Absolutely love these. They always help SO SO much with my stubborn acne.
These little patches work so well I have shared them with friends

I have used the Original Mighty patches for years( & restock on repeat!). But, with this new duo box of original and invisible + patches; I cannot only have my favorite Original, but the Invisible + patches too! One patch for day and one patch for night- love it! Literally the best of both worlds! Thank you Hero for the free box!
